subject: prd/installer
statement: When `pyxis init` runs interactively, it shall elicit at most four knobs (tracker · CI mode · CLI surfaces · argus enablement), each with a recommended default, plus one repository question naming the install's destination — an existing empty repository the credential can write to, a new repository to create, or a local-only install with no GitHub — deriving the GitHub wiring depth from that answer instead of asking it, suppressing the GitHub-only questions where the answer declares no GitHub (FR-25), persisting every answer plus every path, pin, and branch value the engine consumes into the repo config, and asking nothing further.
rationale: one decision, one question: the destination determines the wiring depth, so asking them separately invites a contradiction the operator only discovers at the end; complete capture, no implicit paths
fit_criterion: post-init config contains the same five knob keys and the complete path/pin/branch key set, closed-schema valid; the interactive transcript asks exactly the repository question plus the applicable knobs — neither a `wiring.repo` enum question nor a separate coordinate exchange appears; a local-only answer leaves the tracker, CI-mode, and protection questions unasked
